import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def pct(n, d):
    return 0.0 if d == 0 else (n / d) * 100.0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SENTINEL CERT FN/FP ?먯씤 遺꾩꽍")
    ap.add_argument(
        "--input",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/evaluation_event_details.csv",
        help="cert_evaluate.py媛 ?앹꽦???대깽?몃퀎 ?됯? 寃곌낵 CSV",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--threshold",
        type=float,
        default=30.0,
        help="?먯? ?먯젙 risk_score 湲곗?媛?(湲곕낯 30)",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/analysis",
        help="遺꾩꽍 寃곌낵 ????대뜑",
    )
    args = ap.parse_args()

    src = Path(args.input)
    outdir = Path(args.output_dir)
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(src, encoding="utf-8-sig", low_memory=False)

    required = {"raw_event_id", "user", "event_type", "risk_score", "is_malicious"}
    missing = required - set(df.columns)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"?꾩닔 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎: {sorted(missing)}")

    df["risk_score"] = pd.to_numeric(df["risk_score"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
    df["is_malicious"] = (
        df["is_malicious"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        .isin(["true", "1", "yes"])
    )
    df["predicted"] = df["risk_score"] >= args.threshold

    df["result_type"] = "TN"
    df.loc[df["is_malicious"] & df["predicted"], "result_type"] = "TP"
    df.loc[df["is_malicious"] & ~df["predicted"], "result_type"] = "FN"
    df.loc[~df["is_malicious"] & df["predicted"], "result_type"] = "FP"

    tp = df[df["result_type"] == "TP"]
    fn = df[df["result_type"] == "FN"]
    fp = df[df["result_type"] == "FP"]
    tn = df[df["result_type"] == "TN"]

    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"SENTINEL CERT ?ㅻ쪟 遺꾩꽍 | threshold >= {args.threshold:g}")
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"?꾩껜: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"TP: {len(tp):,} | FN: {len(fn):,} | FP: {len(fp):,} | TN: {len(tn):,}")
    print(f"?먯??? {pct(len(tp), len(tp)+len(fn)):.2f}%")
    print(f"?ㅽ깘瑜? {pct(len(fp), len(fp)+len(tn)):.2f}%")

    # 1) ?낆꽦 ?대깽??醫낅쪟蹂??먯?/誘명깘
    mal = df[df["is_malicious"]].copy()
    by_event = (
        mal.groupby("event_type")
        .agg(
            malicious_count=("raw_event_id", "count"),
            detected=("predicted", "sum"),
            avg_score=("risk_score", "mean"),
            median_score=("risk_score", "median"),
            max_score=("risk_score", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    by_event["missed"] = by_event["malicious_count"] - by_event["detected"]
    by_event["detection_rate_pct"] = (
        by_event["detected"] / by_event["malicious_count"] * 100
    ).round(2)
    by_event = by_event.sort_values(
        ["missed", "malicious_count"], ascending=[False, False]
    )

    print("\n[1] ?낆꽦 ?대깽??醫낅쪟蹂??먯? ?꾪솴")
    print(by_event.to_string(index=False))

    # 2) FN 醫낅쪟蹂?    fn_event = (
        fn.groupby("event_type")
        .agg(
            fn_count=("raw_event_id", "count"),
            avg_score=("risk_score", "mean"),
            median_score=("risk_score", "median"),
            max_score=("risk_score", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values("fn_count", ascending=False)
    )

    print("\n[2] FN(誘명깘) ?대깽??醫낅쪟")
    if len(fn_event):
        print(fn_event.to_string(index=False))
    else:
        print("FN ?놁쓬")

    # 3) FP 醫낅쪟蹂?    fp_event = (
        fp.groupby("event_type")
        .agg(
            fp_count=("raw_event_id", "count"),
            avg_score=("risk_score", "mean"),
            median_score=("risk_score", "median"),
            max_score=("risk_score", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values("fp_count", ascending=False)
    )

    print("\n[3] FP(?ㅽ깘) ?대깽??醫낅쪟")
    if len(fp_event):
        print(fp_event.to_string(index=False))
    else:
        print("FP ?놁쓬")

    # 4) ?먯닔 援ш컙
    bins = [-0.001, 9.999, 19.999, 29.999, 39.999, 49.999, 59.999, 79.999, 1000]
    labels = ["0-9", "10-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-79", "80+"]
    df["score_band"] = pd.cut(df["risk_score"], bins=bins, labels=labels)

    score_dist = (
        df.groupby(["score_band", "is_malicious"], observed=True)
        .size()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
        .rename(columns={False: "normal", True: "malicious"})
        .reset_index()
    )
    for col in ["normal", "malicious"]:
        if col not in score_dist.columns:
            score_dist[col] = 0

    print("\n[4] ?꾪뿕?먯닔 援ш컙蹂??뺤긽/?낆꽦 遺꾪룷")
    print(score_dist.to_string(index=False))

    # 5) FN??留롮? ?ъ슜??    fn_user = (
        fn.groupby("user")
        .agg(
            fn_count=("raw_event_id", "count"),
            avg_score=("risk_score", "mean"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values("fn_count", ascending=False)
        .head(20)
    )

    print("\n[5] FN??留롮? ?ъ슜??TOP 20")
    if len(fn_user):
        print(fn_user.to_string(index=False))
    else:
        print("FN ?놁쓬")

    # 6) FP媛 留롮? ?ъ슜??    fp_user = (
        fp.groupby("user")
        .agg(
            fp_count=("raw_event_id", "count"),
            avg_score=("risk_score", "mean"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values("fp_count", ascending=False)
        .head(20)
    )

    print("\n[6] FP媛 留롮? ?ъ슜??TOP 20")
    if len(fp_user):
        print(fp_user.to_string(index=False))
    else:
        print("FP ?놁쓬")

    # 7) raw detail save
    by_event.to_csv(outdir / "malicious_by_event_type.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fn_event.to_csv(outdir / "fn_by_event_type.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fp_event.to_csv(outdir / "fp_by_event_type.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    score_dist.to_csv(outdir / "score_distribution.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fn_user.to_csv(outdir / "fn_users_top20.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fp_user.to_csv(outdir / "fp_users_top20.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fn.to_csv(outdir / "false_negatives.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    fp.to_csv(outdir / "false_positives.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    print("\n[?꾨즺]")
    print(f"遺꾩꽍 寃곌낵 ????대뜑: {outdir}")
    print("?뱁엳 ?꾨옒 異쒕젰 3媛쒕? 蹂대궡二쇰㈃ ?ㅼ쓬 洹쒖튃 ?섏젙 媛??")
    print("  1) [1] ?낆꽦 ?대깽??醫낅쪟蹂??먯? ?꾪솴")
    print("  2) [2] FN(誘명깘) ?대깽??醫낅쪟")
    print("  3) [3] FP(?ㅽ깘) ?대깽??醫낅쪟")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def norm_ver(v):
    return str(v).strip().lower().replace("r", "")


def find_insiders_csv(root: Path) -> Path:
    hits = list(root.rglob("insiders.csv"))
    if not hits:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"insiders.csv瑜?李얠? 紐삵뻽?듬땲?? {root}")
    return hits[0]


def resolve_detail_file(root: Path, row) -> Path | None:
    details = str(row.get("details", "")).strip()
    scenario = str(row.get("scenario", "")).strip()
    dataset = norm_ver(row.get("dataset", ""))

    if not details or details.lower() == "nan":
        return None

    candidates = [
        root / details,
        root / f"r{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
        root / f"{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
    ]
    for p in candidates:
        if p.exists():
            return p

    hits = list(root.rglob(Path(details).name))
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def load_malicious_ids(answers_root: Path, dataset="4.2"):
    insiders_path = find_insiders_csv(answers_root)
    insiders = pd.read_csv(insiders_path)

    insiders = insiders[
        insiders["dataset"].astype(str).map(norm_ver) == norm_ver(dataset)
    ].copy()

    mal_ids = set()
    for _, row in insiders.iterrows():
        p = resolve_detail_file(insiders_path.parent, row)
        if p is None:
            p = resolve_detail_file(answers_root, row)
        if p is None or not p.exists():
            continue

        with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore", newline="") as f:
            reader = csv.reader(f)
            for fields in reader:
                if len(fields) < 2:
                    continue
                event_id = fields[1].strip().strip('"')
                if event_id and event_id.lower() not in {"id", "event_id"}:
                    mal_ids.add(event_id)

    return mal_ids


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source", default="data/cert_r4.2/normalized_events.csv")
    parser.add_argument("--answers", default="data/cert_r4.2/answers")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", default="4.2")
    parser.add_argument("--size", type=int, default=100000)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/evaluation_sample_100k.csv",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source = Path(args.source)
    answers = Path(args.answers)
    output = Path(args.output)

    print("[1/4] ?낆꽦 ?대깽??ID 濡쒕뵫...")
    mal_ids = load_malicious_ids(answers, args.dataset)
    print(f"  - ?꾩껜 ?낆꽦 ?대깽??ID: {len(mal_ids):,}媛?)

    print("[2/4] ?뺢퇋???대깽??濡쒕뵫...")
    df = pd.read_csv(source, low_memory=False)
    if "raw_event_id" not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("source CSV??raw_event_id 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎.")

    df["raw_event_id"] = df["raw_event_id"].astype(str).str.strip()

    malicious = df[df["raw_event_id"].isin(mal_ids)].copy()
    normal = df[~df["raw_event_id"].isin(mal_ids)].copy()

    print(f"  - source ???낆꽦 ?대깽?? {len(malicious):,}嫄?)
    print(f"  - source ???뺤긽 ?대깽?? {len(normal):,}嫄?)

    if len(malicious) == 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "?꾩옱 normalized_events.csv ?먯껜???낆꽦 ?대깽?멸? ?놁뒿?덈떎.\n"
            "?꾩껜 CERT ?곗씠?곗뿉??normalized_events.csv瑜??ㅼ떆 留뚮뱾?댁빞 ?⑸땲??"
        )

    if len(malicious) >= args.size:
        sample = malicious.sample(n=args.size, random_state=args.seed)
    else:
        normal_needed = args.size - len(malicious)
        if normal_needed > len(normal):
            normal_needed = len(normal)

        normal_sample = normal.sample(
            n=normal_needed,
            random_state=args.seed,
        )
        sample = pd.concat([malicious, normal_sample], ignore_index=True)

    # ?ㅼ젣 ?쒗??遺꾩꽍???꾪빐 ?쒓컙???뺣젹
    if "timestamp" in sample.columns:
        sample["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(sample["timestamp"], errors="coerce")
        sample = sample.sort_values("timestamp", kind="mergesort")

    sample["is_malicious_ground_truth"] = (
        sample["raw_event_id"].isin(mal_ids)
    ).astype(int)

    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sample.to_csv(output, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    print("[3/4] ?됯? ?명듃 ?앹꽦 ?꾨즺")
    print(f"  - 珥??대깽?? {len(sample):,}嫄?)
    print(f"  - ?낆꽦 ?대깽?? {int(sample['is_malicious_ground_truth'].sum()):,}嫄?)
    print(f"  - ?뺤긽 ?대깽?? {len(sample) - int(sample['is_malicious_ground_truth'].sum()):,}嫄?)

    print("[4/4] ????꾨즺")
    print(f"  - {output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import csv
import math
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd


def find_insiders_csv(root: Path) -> Path:
    hits = list(root.rglob('insiders.csv'))
    if not hits:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'insiders.csv瑜?李얠? 紐삵뻽?듬땲?? {root}')
    return hits[0]


def norm_ver(v):
    return str(v).strip().lower().replace('r', '')


def resolve_detail(root: Path, row):
    details = str(row.get('details', '')).strip()
    scenario = str(row.get('scenario', '')).strip()
    dataset = norm_ver(row.get('dataset', ''))
    if not details or details.lower() == 'nan':
        return None
    candidates = [
        root / details,
        root / f'r{dataset}-{scenario}' / details,
        root / f'{dataset}-{scenario}' / details,
    ]
    for p in candidates:
        if p.exists():
            return p
    hits = list(root.rglob(Path(details).name))
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def load_malicious_ids(answers_root: Path, dataset='4.2'):
    insiders_path = find_insiders_csv(answers_root)
    insiders = pd.read_csv(insiders_path)
    insiders = insiders[insiders['dataset'].astype(str).map(norm_ver) == norm_ver(dataset)].copy()
    malicious_ids = set()
    parsed = 0
    missing = []
    for _, row in insiders.iterrows():
        detail = resolve_detail(insiders_path.parent, row) or resolve_detail(answers_root, row)
        if detail is None:
            missing.append(str(row.get('details', '')))
            continue
        parsed += 1
        with detail.open('r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore', newline='') as f:
            for fields in csv.reader(f):
                if len(fields) < 2:
                    continue
                event_id = fields[1].strip().strip('"')
                if event_id and event_id.lower() not in {'id', 'event_id'}:
                    malicious_ids.add(event_id)
    return insiders_path, insiders, malicious_ids, parsed, missing


def load_predictions(db_path: Path, ids: set[str]):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        cols = [r[1] for r in conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(security_events)').fetchall()]
        need = {'raw_event_id', 'risk_score', 'risk_level'}
        missing = need - set(cols)
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f'DB???꾩슂??而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎: {sorted(missing)}')
        q = 'SELECT raw_event_id, risk_score, risk_level FROM security_events WHERE raw_event_id IS NOT NULL'
        df = pd.read_sql_query(q, conn)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    df['raw_event_id'] = df['raw_event_id'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df[df['raw_event_id'].isin(ids)].copy()
    df['risk_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['risk_score'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)
    return df.groupby('raw_event_id', as_index=False).agg(risk_score=('risk_score','max'), risk_level=('risk_level','last'))


def safe(a,b):
    return a/b if b else float('nan')


def pct(v):
    return 'N/A' if math.isnan(v) else f'{v*100:.2f}%'


def evaluate(df, t):
    y = df['is_malicious'].astype(bool)
    p = df['risk_score'] >= t
    tp = int((y & p).sum()); tn = int((~y & ~p).sum())
    fp = int((~y & p).sum()); fn = int((y & ~p).sum())
    precision = safe(tp, tp+fp); recall = safe(tp, tp+fn); fpr = safe(fp, fp+tn)
    accuracy = safe(tp+tn, len(df))
    f1 = float('nan') if math.isnan(precision) or math.isnan(recall) or precision+recall == 0 else 2*precision*recall/(precision+recall)
    return dict(threshold=t,tp=tp,tn=tn,fp=fp,fn=fn,precision=precision,recall=recall,fpr=fpr,accuracy=accuracy,f1=f1)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--normalized', default='data/cert_r4.2/normalized_events.csv')
    ap.add_argument('--db', default='data/security.db')
    ap.add_argument('--answers', default='data/cert_r4.2/answers')
    ap.add_argument('--dataset', default='4.2')
    ap.add_argument('--threshold', type=float, default=60.0)
    ap.add_argument('--output', default='data/cert_r4.2/evaluation_results.csv')
    a = ap.parse_args()

    print('[1/4] normalized events 濡쒕뵫...')
    events = pd.read_csv(a.normalized, low_memory=False)
    required = {'raw_event_id','timestamp','user','event_type'}
    miss = required - set(events.columns)
    if miss:
        raise ValueError(f'normalized_events.csv???꾩슂??而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎: {sorted(miss)}')
    events['raw_event_id'] = events['raw_event_id'].astype(str).str.strip()
    ids = set(events['raw_event_id'])
    print(f'  - ?됯? ????대깽?? {len(events):,}嫄?)

    print('[2/4] CERT ground truth 濡쒕뵫...')
    insiders_path, insiders, mal_ids, parsed, missing = load_malicious_ids(Path(a.answers), a.dataset)
    overlap = ids & mal_ids
    print(f'  - insiders.csv: {insiders_path}')
    print(f'  - r{a.dataset} ?쒕굹由ъ삤 ?? {len(insiders):,}媛?)
    print(f'  - ?쎌? ?곸꽭 ?뺣떟 ?뚯씪: {parsed:,}媛?)
    print(f'  - ?꾩껜 ?낆꽦 ?대깽??ID: {len(mal_ids):,}媛?)
    print(f'  - ?꾩옱 10留?嫄닿낵 寃뱀튂???낆꽦 ?대깽?? {len(overlap):,}嫄?)
    if missing:
        print(f'  - 李얠? 紐삵븳 ?곸꽭 ?뚯씪: {len(missing):,}媛?)

    print('[3/4] SENTINEL ?꾪뿕?먯닔 濡쒕뵫...')
    pred = load_predictions(Path(a.db), ids)
    print(f'  - DB? 留ㅼ묶??怨좎쑀 ?대깽?? {len(pred):,}嫄?)

    merged['is_malicious'] = merged['raw_event_id'].isin(mal_ids)

    print('[4/4] ?깅뒫 ?됯?...')
    if int(merged['is_malicious'].sum()) == 0:
        print('\n[以묒슂] ?꾩옱 ?섑뵆??CERT ?낆꽦 ?대깽?멸? 0嫄댁엯?덈떎.')
        print('??寃쎌슦 ?먯??⑥? 怨꾩궛?????녾퀬, ?ㅽ깘瑜좊쭔 ?섎?媛 ?덉뒿?덈떎.')

    thresholds = sorted(set([30.0, 60.0, 80.0, float(a.threshold)]))
    results = []
    for t in thresholds:
        r = evaluate(merged, t); results.append(r)
        print(f'\n--- Risk threshold >= {t:g} ---')
        print(f"TP: {r['tp']:,} | FP: {r['fp']:,} | TN: {r['tn']:,} | FN: {r['fn']:,}")
        print(f"Precision: {pct(r['precision'])}")
        print(f"?먯???Recall/TPR): {pct(r['recall'])}")
        print(f"?ㅽ깘瑜?FPR): {pct(r['fpr'])}")
        print(f"Accuracy: {pct(r['accuracy'])}")
        print(f"F1-score: {pct(r['f1'])}")

    out = Path(a.output); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(results).to_csv(out, index=False, encoding='utf-8-sig')
    merged.to_csv(out.with_name('evaluation_event_details.csv'), index=False, encoding='utf-8-sig')
    print(f'\n[?꾨즺] ?됯? ?붿빟: {out}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import heapq
import os
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Iterable, Iterator, Optional


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_CERT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "data" / "cert_r4.2"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT = DEFAULT_CERT_DIR / "normalized_events.csv"

OUTPUT_FIELDS = [
    "timestamp",
    "user",
    "event_type",
    "host",
    "source_ip",
    "process_name",
    "file_name",
    "file_path",
    "file_access_count",
    "usb_connected",
    "device_name",
    "device_id",
    "source",
    "raw_event_id",
]

# CERT r4.2???쇰컲?곸씤 ?좎쭨 ?뺤떇. ?뱀떆 ?ㅻⅨ 誘몃윭?먯꽌 ISO ?뺤떇?쇰줈 ?쒓났?대룄 泥섎━?쒕떎.
DATE_FORMATS = (
    "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
    "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M",
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
)


def clean(value: Optional[str]) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


def get_value(row: Dict[str, str], *names: str) -> str:
    # 誘몃윭/?꾩쿂由щ낯?먯꽌 ?ㅻ뜑 ??뚮Ц?먭? ?щ씪???숈옉?섎룄濡?泥섎━
    lowered = {str(k).strip().lower(): v for k, v in row.items() if k is not None}
    for name in names:
        value = lowered.get(name.lower())
        if value is not None:
            return clean(value)
    return ""


def parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
    value = clean(value)
    if not value:
        raise ValueError("?좎쭨 媛믪씠 鍮꾩뼱 ?덉뒿?덈떎.")

    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    # Python???댄빐?섎뒗 ISO 蹂?뺤? 留덉?留됱쑝濡???踰????쒕룄
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"吏?먰븯吏 ?딅뒗 ?좎쭨 ?뺤떇: {value}") from exc


def normalize_logon(row: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    activity = get_value(row, "activity", "action", "event")
    activity_lower = activity.lower()

    if "logoff" in activity_lower or "logout" in activity_lower:
        event_type = "logout"
    else:
        # CERT logon.csv??Logon? ?깃났???몄뀡 ?쒖옉 ?대깽?몃줈 痍④툒?쒕떎.
        event_type = "login_success"

    ts = parse_timestamp(get_value(row, "date", "timestamp", "time"))

    return {
        "timestamp": ts.isoformat(sep=" "),
        "user": get_value(row, "user", "username"),
        "event_type": event_type,
        "host": get_value(row, "pc", "host", "computer"),
        "source_ip": "",
        "process_name": "",
        "file_name": "",
        "file_path": "",
        "file_access_count": "0",
        "usb_connected": "0",
        "device_name": "",
        "device_id": "",
        "source": "cert_r4.2_logon",
        "raw_event_id": get_value(row, "id", "event_id"),
    }


def normalize_device(row: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    activity = get_value(row, "activity", "action", "event")
    activity_lower = activity.lower()
    connected = 0 if ("disconnect" in activity_lower or "remove" in activity_lower) else 1
    event_type = "usb_disconnect" if connected == 0 else "usb_connect"
    ts = parse_timestamp(get_value(row, "date", "timestamp", "time"))

    return {
        "timestamp": ts.isoformat(sep=" "),
        "user": get_value(row, "user", "username"),
        "event_type": event_type,
        "host": get_value(row, "pc", "host", "computer"),
        "source_ip": "",
        "process_name": "",
        "file_name": "",
        "file_path": "",
        "file_access_count": "0",
        "usb_connected": str(connected),
        "device_name": get_value(row, "device", "device_name"),
        "device_id": get_value(row, "device_id", "serial", "id"),
        "source": "cert_r4.2_device",
        "raw_event_id": get_value(row, "id", "event_id"),
    }


def normalize_file(row: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    file_path = get_value(row, "filename", "file", "file_path", "path")
    file_name = Path(file_path.replace("\\", "/")).name if file_path else ""
    ts = parse_timestamp(get_value(row, "date", "timestamp", "time"))

    return {
        "timestamp": ts.isoformat(sep=" "),
        "user": get_value(row, "user", "username"),
        "event_type": "file_access",
        "host": get_value(row, "pc", "host", "computer"),
        "source_ip": "",
        "process_name": "",
        "file_name": file_name,
        "file_path": file_path,
        "file_access_count": "1",
        "usb_connected": "0",
        "device_name": "",
        "device_id": "",
        "source": "cert_r4.2_file",
        "raw_event_id": get_value(row, "id", "event_id"),
    }


def validate_columns(path: Path, kind: str) -> None:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="", errors="replace") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        header = next(reader, None)

    if not header:
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: ?ㅻ뜑媛 ?놁뒿?덈떎.")

    normalized = {h.strip().lower() for h in header}
    required = {"date", "user", "pc"}
    missing = required - normalized
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{path.name}: ?꾩닔 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}\n"
            f"?꾩옱 ?ㅻ뜑: {header}"
        )

    if kind == "logon" and "activity" not in normalized:
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: activity 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎. ?꾩옱 ?ㅻ뜑: {header}")
    if kind == "device" and "activity" not in normalized:
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: activity 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎. ?꾩옱 ?ㅻ뜑: {header}")
    if kind == "file" and not ({"filename", "file", "file_path", "path"} & normalized):
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: filename/file_path 怨꾩뿴 而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎. ?꾩옱 ?ㅻ뜑: {header}")


def read_normalized(path: Path, kind: str) -> Iterator[Dict[str, str]]:
    normalizer = {
        "logon": normalize_logon,
        "device": normalize_device,
        "file": normalize_file,
    }[kind]

    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="", errors="replace") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for line_no, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            try:
                item = normalizer(row)
                if not item["user"] or not item["timestamp"]:
                    continue
                yield item
            except Exception as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"{path.name} {line_no}??蹂???ㅽ뙣: {exc}") from exc


def write_sorted_chunk(rows: list[Dict[str, str]], temp_dir: Path, chunk_no: int) -> Path:
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["timestamp"])
    path = temp_dir / f"chunk_{chunk_no:05d}.csv"
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=OUTPUT_FIELDS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    return path


def chunk_iterator(path: Path) -> Iterator[Dict[str, str]]:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        yield from reader


def normalize_dataset(cert_dir: Path, output: Path, limit: Optional[int], chunk_size: int) -> int:
    sources = [
        (cert_dir / "logon.csv", "logon"),
        (cert_dir / "device.csv", "device"),
        (cert_dir / "file.csv", "file"),
    ]

    for path, kind in sources:
        if not path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"?꾩슂???뚯씪???놁뒿?덈떎: {path}")
        validate_columns(path, kind)

    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ?섎갚留?嫄대룄 硫붾え由???＜ ?놁씠 泥섎━?섍린 ?꾪빐 ?뺣젹???꾩떆 chunk瑜?留뚮뱺 ??merge?쒕떎.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cert_normalize_") as tmp:
        temp_dir = Path(tmp)
        chunk_paths: list[Path] = []
        buffer: list[Dict[str, str]] = []
        chunk_no = 0

        print("[1/3] CERT CSV 蹂??以?..")
        for path, kind in sources:
            print(f"  - {path.name}")
            for item in read_normalized(path, kind):
                buffer.append(item)
                if len(buffer) >= chunk_size:
                    chunk_paths.append(write_sorted_chunk(buffer, temp_dir, chunk_no))
                    chunk_no += 1
                    buffer = []

        if buffer:
            chunk_paths.append(write_sorted_chunk(buffer, temp_dir, chunk_no))

        print(f"[2/3] ?쒓컙??蹂묓빀 以?.. ({len(chunk_paths)}媛?chunk)")
        iterators = [chunk_iterator(p) for p in chunk_paths]

        # heapq.merge??媛?iterator媛 ?대? ?뺣젹???덉쑝誘濡??꾩껜 ?뚯씪??硫붾え由ъ뿉 ?щ━吏 ?딅뒗??
        merged = heapq.merge(*iterators, key=lambda r: r["timestamp"])

        count = 0
        source_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        event_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}

        try:
            with output.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=OUTPUT_FIELDS)
                writer.writeheader()

                for row in merged:
                    writer.writerow(row)
                    count += 1
                    source_counts[row["source"]] = source_counts.get(row["source"], 0) + 1
                    event_counts[row["event_type"]] = event_counts.get(row["event_type"], 0) + 1

                    if limit is not None and count >= limit:
                        break
        finally:
            # Windows?먯꽌??limit???꾨떖??merge瑜?以묎컙 醫낅즺?섎㈃
            # 媛?chunk generator媛 ?뚯씪 ?몃뱾??怨꾩냽 ?↔퀬 ?덉쓣 ???덈떎.
            # TemporaryDirectory ?뺣━ ?꾩뿉 紐낆떆?곸쑝濡?紐⑤몢 ?ル뒗??
            close_merged = getattr(merged, "close", None)
            if callable(close_merged):
                close_merged()
            for it in iterators:
                close_it = getattr(it, "close", None)
                if callable(close_it):
                    close_it()

    print("[3/3] ?꾨즺")
    print(f"異쒕젰 ?뚯씪: {output}")
    print(f"珥??대깽?? {count:,}嫄?)
    print("?대깽??醫낅쪟:")
    for key, value in sorted(event_counts.items()):
        print(f"  {key}: {value:,}")

    return count


def preview(cert_dir: Path) -> None:
    sources = [
        (cert_dir / "logon.csv", "logon"),
        (cert_dir / "device.csv", "device"),
        (cert_dir / "file.csv", "file"),
    ]
    for path, kind in sources:

            print(f"[X] {path.name}: ?놁쓬")
            continue
        try:
            validate_columns(path, kind)
            size_mb = path.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024
            print(f"[OK] {path.name}: {size_mb:.1f} MB")
            rows = read_normalized(path, kind)
            first = next(rows, None)
            if first:
                print(f"     ?덉떆: {first}")
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"[ERROR] {path.name}: {exc}")

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import text

from server.database import SessionLocal
from server.main import EventCreate, process_security_event

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_CSV = ROOT / "data" / "cert_r4.2" / "normalized_events.csv"


def as_int(value, default=0):
    try:
        return int(str(value or "").strip() or default)
    except ValueError:
        return default


def parse_ts(value: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value.strip())


def to_event(row: dict[str, str]) -> EventCreate:
    event_type = (row.get("event_type") or "").strip()
    usb_connected = as_int(row.get("usb_connected"), 0)

    # ?꾨줈?앺듃 ?대??먯꽌 湲곗〈???ъ슜?섎뜕 event_type 紐낆묶怨?留욎텣??
    if event_type == "usb_connect":
        normalized_type = "usb_connected"
    elif event_type == "usb_disconnect":
        normalized_type = "usb_disconnected"
    else:
        normalized_type = event_type

    login_success = None
    if normalized_type == "login_success":
        login_success = 1

    return EventCreate(
        user=(row.get("user") or "").strip(),
        event_type=normalized_type,
        timestamp=parse_ts(row["timestamp"]),
        host=(row.get("host") or "").strip() or None,
        source=(row.get("source") or "cert_r4.2").strip(),
        raw_event_id=(row.get("raw_event_id") or "").strip() or None,
        source_ip=(row.get("source_ip") or "").strip() or None,
        login_success=login_success,
        login_fail_count=0,
        file_name=(row.get("file_name") or "").strip() or None,
        file_path=(row.get("file_path") or "").strip() or None,
        file_grade=None,
        file_access_count=as_int(row.get("file_access_count"), 0),
        usb_connected=usb_connected,
        device_name=(row.get("device_name") or "").strip() or None,
        device_id=(row.get("device_id") or "").strip() or None,
        process_name=(row.get("process_name") or "").strip() or None,
    )


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="CERT 怨듯넻 ?대깽?몃? SENTINEL 遺꾩꽍 ?붿쭊?쇰줈 ?ъ깮")
    parser.add_argument("--csv", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CSV)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--progress", type=int, default=1000)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    csv_path = args.csv.resolve()
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"CSV媛 ?놁뒿?덈떎: {csv_path}")

    db = SessionLocal()

    # CERT ????ъ깮??SQLite ?쒕떇.
    # 遺꾩꽍 濡쒖쭅/?꾪뿕?먯닔 怨꾩궛? 諛붽씀吏 ?딄퀬 ?붿뒪???숆린??鍮꾩슜留?以꾩씤??
    try:
        db.execute(text("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL"))
        db.execute(text("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL"))
        db.execute(text("PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY"))
        db.execute(text("PRAGMA cache_size=-65536"))  # ??64MB
        db.commit()
    except Exception as exc:
        db.rollback()
        print(f"[WARN] SQLite ?깅뒫 ?ㅼ젙 ?쇰? ?곸슜 ?ㅽ뙣: {exc}")
    processed = 0
    failed = 0
    started = time.perf_counter()

    try:
        with csv_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
            reader = csv.DictReader(f)
            for row_no, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
                if args.limit is not None and processed >= args.limit:
                    break

                try:
                    event = to_event(row)
                    if not event.user:
                        continue
                    process_security_event(event, db, perf_logging=False)
                    processed += 1
                except Exception as exc:
                    failed += 1
                    db.rollback()
                    print(f"[ERROR] {row_no}?? {exc}")

                if args.progress > 0 and processed and processed % args.progress == 0:
                    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
                    rate = processed / elapsed if elapsed else 0
                    print(f"[吏꾪뻾] {processed:,}嫄?| ?ㅽ뙣 {failed:,}嫄?| {rate:,.1f}嫄?珥?)

        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
        print("\n[?꾨즺]")
        print(f"泥섎━ ?깃났: {processed:,}嫄?)
        print(f"泥섎━ ?ㅽ뙣: {failed:,}嫄?)
        print(f"珥?泥섎━?쒓컙: {elapsed:,.2f}珥?)
        if elapsed:
            print(f"?됯퇏 泥섎━?띾룄: {processed / elapsed:,.1f}嫄?珥?)
    finally:
        db.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def norm_ver(v):
    return str(v).strip().lower().replace("r", "")


def find_insiders_csv(root: Path) -> Path:
    hits = list(root.rglob("insiders.csv"))
    if not hits:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"insiders.csv瑜?李얠? 紐삵뻽?듬땲?? {root}")
    return hits[0]


def resolve_detail_file(root: Path, row) -> Path | None:
    details = str(row.get("details", "")).strip()
    scenario = str(row.get("scenario", "")).strip()
    dataset = norm_ver(row.get("dataset", ""))

    if not details or details.lower() == "nan":
        return None

    candidates = [
        root / details,
        root / f"r{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
        root / f"{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
    ]

    for p in candidates:
        if p.exists():
            return p

    hits = list(root.rglob(Path(details).name))
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def load_scenarios(answers_root: Path, dataset="4.2"):
    insiders_path = find_insiders_csv(answers_root)
    insiders = pd.read_csv(insiders_path)

    insiders = insiders[
        insiders["dataset"].astype(str).map(norm_ver) == norm_ver(dataset)
    ].copy()

    scenarios = []

    for idx, row in insiders.iterrows():
        detail_file = resolve_detail_file(insiders_path.parent, row)
        if detail_file is None:
            detail_file = resolve_detail_file(answers_root, row)

        event_ids = set()

        if detail_file and detail_file.exists():
            with detail_file.open(
                "r",
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="ignore",
                newline=""
            ) as f:
                reader = csv.reader(f)
                for fields in reader:
                    if len(fields) < 2:
                        continue
                    event_id = fields[1].strip().strip('"')
                    if event_id and event_id.lower() not in {"id", "event_id"}:
                        event_ids.add(event_id)

        scenarios.append(
            {
                "scenario_row": idx + 1,
                "scenario": str(row.get("scenario", "")),
                "user": str(row.get("user", "")),
                "details": str(row.get("details", "")),
                "event_ids": event_ids,
            }
        )

    return insiders_path, scenarios


def load_event_scores(path: Path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8-sig", low_memory=False)

    required = {"raw_event_id", "risk_score"}
    missing = required - set(df.columns)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"?됯? ?곸꽭 CSV???꾩슂??而щ읆???놁뒿?덈떎: {sorted(missing)}")

    df["raw_event_id"] = df["raw_event_id"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["risk_score"] = pd.to_numeric(df["risk_score"], errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)

    # raw_event_id 以묐났 ??媛???믪? ?먯닔
    scores = (
        df.groupby("raw_event_id", as_index=False)
        .agg(risk_score=("risk_score", "max"))
    )

    return dict(zip(scores["raw_event_id"], scores["risk_score"]))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="CERT r4.2 ?쒕굹由ъ삤 ?⑥쐞 ?먯? ?됯?")
    ap.add_argument(
        "--answers",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/answers",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--details",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/evaluation_event_details.csv",
        help="cert_evaluate.py媛 留뚮뱺 ?대깽?몃퀎 ?됯? ?곸꽭 CSV",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--dataset",
        default="4.2",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--threshold",
        type=float,
        default=30.0,
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--output",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/scenario_evaluation.csv",
    )
    args = ap.parse_args()

    print("[1/3] CERT ?쒕굹由ъ삤 濡쒕뵫...")
    insiders_path, scenarios = load_scenarios(
        Path(args.answers),
        args.dataset
    )
    print(f"  - insiders.csv: {insiders_path}")
    print(f"  - ?쒕굹由ъ삤 ?? {len(scenarios)}媛?)

    print("[2/3] SENTINEL ?대깽???먯닔 濡쒕뵫...")
    score_map = load_event_scores(Path(args.details))
    print(f"  - ?됯? ?대깽???먯닔: {len(score_map):,}媛?)

    rows = []

    for s in scenarios:
        ids = s["event_ids"]

        in_sample = [eid for eid in ids if eid in score_map]
        detected = [
            eid for eid in in_sample
            if score_map[eid] >= args.threshold
        ]

        max_score = (
            max((score_map[eid] for eid in in_sample), default=0.0)
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "scenario_row": s["scenario_row"],
                "scenario": s["scenario"],
                "user": s["user"],
                "details": s["details"],
                "ground_truth_event_count": len(ids),
                "events_in_current_sample": len(in_sample),
                "detected_events": len(detected),
                "scenario_detected": int(len(detected) > 0),
                "max_risk_score": round(float(max_score), 2),
            }
        )

    out_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    evaluable = out_df[out_df["events_in_current_sample"] > 0].copy()
    detected_count = int(evaluable["scenario_detected"].sum())
    evaluable_count = len(evaluable)

    print("[3/3] ?쒕굹由ъ삤 ?⑥쐞 ?됯?")
    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"Risk threshold >= {args.threshold:g}")
    print(f"?꾩껜 CERT r{args.dataset} ?쒕굹由ъ삤: {len(out_df)}媛?)
    print(f"?꾩옱 10留?嫄댁뿉 ?쇰??쇰룄 ?ы븿???쒕굹由ъ삤: {evaluable_count}媛?)
    print(f"?먯????쒕굹由ъ삤: {detected_count}媛?)
    print(
        "?쒕굹由ъ삤 ?먯??? "
        + (
            f"{detected_count / evaluable_count * 100:.2f}%"
            if evaluable_count
            else "N/A"
        )
    )
    print("=" * 72)

    print("\n[誘명깘 ?쒕굹由ъ삤]")
    missed = evaluable[evaluable["scenario_detected"] == 0]
    if missed.empty:
        print("?놁쓬")
    else:
        print(
            missed[
                [
                    "scenario_row",
                    "scenario",
                    "user",
                    "events_in_current_sample",
                    "max_risk_score",
                ]
            ].to_string(index=False)
        )

    out_path = Path(args.output)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_df.to_csv(out_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    print()
    print(f"[?꾨즺] {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import shutil
import py_compile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

engine_code = r'''from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import ipaddress
import re
from sqlalchemy import text

CONTEXT_HISTORY_DAYS = 30
FILE_BURST_MINUTES = 5
FILE_BURST_THRESHOLD = 20
OBSERVE_MIN_COUNT = 3
OBSERVE_MIN_HOURS = 1

SUSPICIOUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS = (
    (r"(?i)(?:-|/)(?:enc|encodedcommand)\b", "PowerShell ?몄퐫??紐낅졊"),
    (r"(?i)\b(?:invoke-webrequest|iwr|wget|curl)\b", "?몃? ?ㅼ슫濡쒕뱶 紐낅졊"),
    (r"(?i)\b(?:downloadstring|downloadfile)\b", "?ㅽ겕由쏀듃 ?ㅼ슫濡쒕뱶 紐낅졊"),
    (r"(?i)\bfrombase64string\b", "Base64 ?붿퐫??紐낅졊"),
    (r"(?i)\b(?:certutil|bitsadmin)\b", "?뚯씪 ?꾩넚/蹂???꾧뎄 ?ㅽ뻾"),
    (r"(?i)\bpowershell(?:\.exe)?\b.*\b(?:-nop|-noprofile|-w\s+hidden|-windowstyle\s+hidden)\b", "???PowerShell ?ㅽ뻾"),
    (r"(?i)\b(?:rundll32|regsvr32|mshta)\b", "LOLBIN 怨꾩뿴 ?ㅽ뻾"),
)

STRONG_CONTEXT_KEYWORDS = (
    "??몃퉬", "誘쇨컧", "USB", "諛섎났 濡쒓렇???ㅽ뙣", "濡쒓렇???ㅽ뙣",
    "?섏떖 紐낅졊", "?몃? ?ㅼ슫濡쒕뱶", "????뚯씪", "怨듦꺽 ?쒗??, "?뺣낫 ?좎텧",
)

def ensure_context_tables(db):
    db.execute(text("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_context (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            event_id INTEGER UNIQUE,
            user TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL,
            source_ip TEXT,
            network_prefix TEXT,
            workstation_name TEXT,
            host TEXT,
            logon_type TEXT,
            command_line TEXT,
            parent_process TEXT,
            is_normal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )
    """))
    db.execute(text("""
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_event_context_user_time
        ON event_context(user, timestamp)
    """))
    db.execute(text("""
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_event_context_user_normal
        ON event_context(user, is_normal)
    """))
    db.execute(text("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS behavior_change_observations (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user TEXT NOT NULL,
            change_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            change_value TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OBSERVING',
            first_seen DATETIME NOT NULL,
            last_seen DATETIME NOT NULL,
            seen_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            max_risk_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            risky_context_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            decision_reason TEXT,
            UNIQUE(user, change_type, change_value)
        )
    """))
    db.commit()

def _clean(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    value = str(value).strip()
    if not value or value == "-":
        return None
    return value

def _network_prefix(source_ip):
    source_ip = _clean(source_ip)
    if not source_ip:
        return None
    try:
        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(source_ip)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if ip.version == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.ip_network(f"{source_ip}/24", strict=False))
    return str(ipaddress.ip_network(f"{source_ip}/64", strict=False))

def _device_key(event):
    workstation = _clean(getattr(event, "workstation_name", None))
    if workstation:
        return workstation
    device_id = _clean(getattr(event, "device_id", None))
    if device_id:
        return device_id
    device_name = _clean(getattr(event, "device_name", None))
    if device_name:
        return device_name
    return _clean(getattr(event, "host", None))

def _history_rows(db, user, reference_time):
    ensure_context_tables(db)
    since = reference_time - timedelta(days=CONTEXT_HISTORY_DAYS)
    return db.execute(
        text("""
            SELECT source_ip, network_prefix, workstation_name, host,
                   logon_type, command_line, parent_process, timestamp
            FROM event_context
            WHERE user=:user
              AND is_normal=1
              AND timestamp < :reference_time
              AND timestamp >= :since
            ORDER BY timestamp DESC
        """),
        {"user": user, "reference_time": reference_time, "since": since},
    ).mappings().all()

def _frequent_values(rows, key, min_count=2):
    counts = {}
    for row in rows:
        value = _clean(row.get(key))
        if value:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    return {value for value, count in counts.items() if count >= min_count}

def _suspicious_command(command_line):
    command_line = _clean(command_line)
    if not command_line:
        return []
    matches = []
    for pattern, label in SUSPICIOUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, command_line):
            matches.append(label)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(matches))

def _recent_file_access_count(db, user, reference_time):
    from server.models import SecurityEvent
    since = reference_time - timedelta(minutes=FILE_BURST_MINUTES)
    rows = (
        db.query(SecurityEvent)
        .filter(
            SecurityEvent.user == user,
            SecurityEvent.event_type == "file_access",
            SecurityEvent.timestamp >= since,
            SecurityEvent.timestamp <= reference_time,
        )
        .all()
    )
    total = 0
    for row in rows:
        count = int(getattr(row, "file_access_count", 0) or 0)
        total += max(1, count)
    return total

def analyze_extended_context(db, event, reference_time=None):
    if reference_time is None:
        reference_time = getattr(event, "timestamp", None) or datetime.now()

    ensure_context_tables(db)

    source_ip = _clean(getattr(event, "source_ip", None))
    network_prefix = _network_prefix(source_ip)
    workstation = _clean(getattr(event, "workstation_name", None))
    host = _clean(getattr(event, "host", None))
    logon_type = _clean(getattr(event, "logon_type", None))
    command_line = _clean(getattr(event, "command_line", None))
    parent_process = _clean(getattr(event, "parent_process", None))

    rows = _history_rows(db, event.user, reference_time)
    score = 0
    reasons = []

    known_prefixes = _frequent_values(rows, "network_prefix", 2)
    if network_prefix and known_prefixes and network_prefix not in known_prefixes:
        score += 15
        reasons.append(f"?됱냼 ?ъ슜 ???낵 ?ㅻⅨ ?ㅽ듃?뚰겕 ?묒냽: {network_prefix}")

    device_value = workstation or _device_key(event)
    known_workstations = _frequent_values(rows, "workstation_name", 2)
    known_hosts = _frequent_values(rows, "host", 2)
    known_devices = known_workstations | known_hosts

    if device_value and known_devices and device_value not in known_devices:
        score += 20
        reasons.append(f"?됱냼 ?ъ슜?섏? ?딅뜕 PC쨌?μ튂?먯꽌???묒냽: {device_value}")

    known_logon_types = _frequent_values(rows, "logon_type", 2)
    if logon_type and known_logon_types and logon_type not in known_logon_types:
        score += 10
        reasons.append(f"?됱냼? ?ㅻⅨ 濡쒓렇???묒냽 ?섍꼍(LogonType {logon_type})")

    command_matches = _suspicious_command(command_line)
    if command_matches:
        score += min(30, 15 + 5 * len(command_matches))
        reasons.append("?섏떖 紐낅졊 ?ㅽ뻾: " + ", ".join(command_matches))

    if getattr(event, "event_type", None) == "file_access":
        recent_count = _recent_file_access_count(db, event.user, reference_time)
        current_count = int(getattr(event, "file_access_count", 0) or 0)
        if recent_count == 0:
            recent_count = max(1, current_count)
        if recent_count >= FILE_BURST_THRESHOLD:
            score += 20
            reasons.append(
                f"{FILE_BURST_MINUTES}遺??대궡 ????뚯씪 ?묎렐 {recent_count}嫄?媛먯?"
            )

    context = {
        "source_ip": source_ip,
        "network_prefix": network_prefix,
        "workstation_name": workstation,
        "host": host,
        "logon_type": logon_type,
        "command_line": command_line,
        "parent_process": parent_process,
    }
    return min(score, 60), reasons, context

def _strong_risk(risk_score, risk_level, reasons):
    if float(risk_score or 0) >= 60:
        return True
    if str(risk_level or "") in ("HIGH", "CRITICAL"):
        return True
    text_value = " ".join(str(x) for x in (reasons or []))
    return any(keyword in text_value for keyword in STRONG_CONTEXT_KEYWORDS)

def _extended_candidates(event):
    result = []
    prefix = _network_prefix(getattr(event, "source_ip", None))
    if prefix:
        result.append(("NETWORK", prefix))
    device = _device_key(event)
    if device:
        result.append(("WORKSTATION", device))
    logon_type = _clean(getattr(event, "logon_type", None))
    if logon_type:
        result.append(("LOGON_TYPE", logon_type))
    return result

def evaluate_extended_behavior_changes(
    db, event, risk_score, risk_level, reasons, reference_time=None
):
    ensure_context_tables(db)
    if reference_time is None:
        reference_time = getattr(event, "timestamp", None) or datetime.now()

    risky = _strong_risk(risk_score, risk_level, reasons)
    output = []

    for change_type, change_value in _extended_candidates(event):
        row = db.execute(
            text("""
                SELECT id, status, first_seen, last_seen, seen_count,
                       max_risk_score, risky_context_count, decision_reason
                FROM behavior_change_observations
                WHERE user=:user
                  AND change_type=:change_type
                  AND change_value=:change_value
            """),
            {
                "user": event.user,
                "change_type": change_type,
                "change_value": change_value,
            },
        ).mappings().first()

        if row is None:
            status = "REJECTED" if risky else "OBSERVING"
            reason = (
                "媛뺥븳 ?꾪뿕 ?좏샇? ?④퍡 泥섏쓬 ?섑????뺤긽 湲곗????숈뒿?먯꽌 ?쒖쇅"
                if risky else
                "???됰룞 媛먯?: ?뺤긽 ?щ? 愿李?以?(1/3??"
            )
            db.execute(
                text("""
                    INSERT INTO behavior_change_observations
                    (
                        user, change_type, change_value, status,
                        first_seen, last_seen, seen_count,
                        max_risk_score, risky_context_count, decision_reason
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        :user, :change_type, :change_value, :status,
                        :now, :now, 1,
                        :risk_score, :risky_count, :reason
                    )
                """),
                {
                    "user": event.user,
                    "change_type": change_type,
                    "change_value": change_value,
                    "status": status,
                    "now": reference_time,
                    "risk_score": float(risk_score or 0),
                    "risky_count": 1 if risky else 0,
                    "reason": reason,
                },
            )
            db.commit()
            output.append({
                "type": change_type,
                "value": change_value,
                "status": status,
                "reason": reason,
            })
            continue

        status = str(row["status"])
        if status in ("ACCEPTED", "REJECTED"):
            output.append({
                "type": change_type,
                "value": change_value,
                "status": status,
                "reason": row["decision_reason"] or (
                    "寃利??꾨즺???뺤긽 蹂??
                    if status == "ACCEPTED"
                    else "?꾪뿕 蹂?붾줈 ?먯젙?섏뼱 ?뺤긽 ?숈뒿?먯꽌 ?쒖쇅"
                ),
            })
            continue

        first_seen = row["first_seen"]
        if isinstance(first_seen, str):
            first_seen = datetime.fromisoformat(first_seen)

        seen_count = int(row["seen_count"] or 0) + 1
        elapsed_hours = (reference_time - first_seen).total_seconds() / 3600.0

        if risky:
            status = "REJECTED"
            reason = "愿李?以?媛뺥븳 ?꾪뿕 留λ씫 ?뺤씤: ?뺤긽 湲곗????숈뒿?먯꽌 ?쒖쇅"
        elif seen_count >= OBSERVE_MIN_COUNT and elapsed_hours >= OBSERVE_MIN_HOURS:
            status = "ACCEPTED"
            reason = (
                f"{OBSERVE_MIN_COUNT}???댁긽쨌{OBSERVE_MIN_HOURS}?쒓컙 ?댁긽 諛섎났 愿李고뻽怨?"
                "媛뺥븳 ?꾪뿕 ?좏샇媛 ?놁뼱 ?뺤긽 蹂?붾줈 ?뱀씤"
            )
        else:
            status = "OBSERVING"
            reason = (
                f"?뺤긽 ?щ? 愿李?以?({seen_count}/{OBSERVE_MIN_COUNT}?? "
                f"{elapsed_hours:.1f}?쒓컙)"
            )

        db.execute(
            text("""
                UPDATE behavior_change_observations
                SET status=:status,
                    last_seen=:last_seen,
                    seen_count=:seen_count,
                    max_risk_score=:max_risk_score,
                    risky_context_count=risky_context_count + :risky_inc,
                    decision_reason=:reason
                WHERE id=:id
            """),
            {
                "status": status,
                "last_seen": reference_time,
                "seen_count": seen_count,
                "max_risk_score": max(
                    float(row["max_risk_score"] or 0),
                    float(risk_score or 0),
                ),
                "risky_inc": 1 if risky else 0,
                "reason": reason,
                "id": row["id"],
            },
        )
        db.commit()
        output.append({
            "type": change_type,
            "value": change_value,
            "status": status,
            "reason": reason,
        })

    return output

def persist_event_context(db, db_event, event, change_results=None):
    ensure_context_tables(db)
    change_results = change_results or []
    blocked = any(
        item.get("status") in ("OBSERVING", "REJECTED")
        for item in change_results
    )
    risk_level = str(getattr(db_event, "risk_level", "") or "")
    is_normal = 1 if (risk_level == "LOW" and not blocked) else 0

    context = {
        "source_ip": _clean(getattr(event, "source_ip", None)),
        "network_prefix": _network_prefix(getattr(event, "source_ip", None)),
        "workstation_name": _clean(getattr(event, "workstation_name", None)),
        "host": _clean(getattr(event, "host", None)),
        "logon_type": _clean(getattr(event, "logon_type", None)),
        "command_line": _clean(getattr(event, "command_line", None)),
        "parent_process": _clean(getattr(event, "parent_process", None)),
    }

    db.execute(
        text("""
            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO event_context
            (
                event_id, user, timestamp,
                source_ip, network_prefix,
                workstation_name, host, logon_type,
                command_line, parent_process,
                is_normal
            )
            VALUES
            (
                :event_id, :user, :timestamp,
                :source_ip, :network_prefix,
                :workstation_name, :host, :logon_type,
                :command_line, :parent_process,
                :is_normal
            )
        """),
        {
            "event_id": db_event.id,
            "user": db_event.user,
            "timestamp": db_event.timestamp,
            **context,
            "is_normal": is_normal,
        },
    )
    db.commit()

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd


def norm_ver(v):
    return str(v).strip().lower().replace("r", "")


def find_insiders_csv(root: Path):
    hits = list(root.rglob("insiders.csv"))
    if not hits:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"insiders.csv not found: {root}")
    return hits[0]


def resolve_detail_file(root: Path, row):
    details = str(row.get("details", "")).strip()
    scenario = str(row.get("scenario", "")).strip()
    dataset = norm_ver(row.get("dataset", ""))

    if not details or details.lower() == "nan":
        return None

    for p in [
        root / details,
        root / f"r{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
        root / f"{dataset}-{scenario}" / details,
    ]:
        if p.exists():
            return p

    hits = list(root.rglob(Path(details).name))
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def load_scenarios(root: Path, dataset="4.2"):
    insiders_path = find_insiders_csv(root)
    insiders = pd.read_csv(insiders_path)

    insiders = insiders[
        insiders["dataset"].astype(str).map(norm_ver)
        == norm_ver(dataset)
    ].copy()

    out = []

    for _, row in insiders.iterrows():
        p = (
            resolve_detail_file(insiders_path.parent, row)
            or resolve_detail_file(root, row)
        )

        ids = set()

        if p and p.exists():
            with p.open(
                "r",
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="ignore",
                newline=""
            ) as f:
                for fields in csv.reader(f):
                    if len(fields) >= 2:
                        eid = fields[1].strip().strip('"')

                        if eid and eid.lower() not in {
                            "id",
                            "event_id"
                        }:
                            ids.add(eid)

        out.append(ids)

    return out


def safe_div(a, b):
    return a / b if b else 0.0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    ap.add_argument(
        "--details",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/evaluation_event_details.csv"
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--answers",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/answers"
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--dataset",
        default="4.2"
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--start",
        type=float,
        default=20.0
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--end",
        type=float,
        default=30.0
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--step",
        type=float,
        default=0.5
    )

    ap.add_argument(
        "--output",
        default="data/cert_r4.2/threshold_sweep.csv"
    )

    args = ap.parse_args()

    df = pd.read_csv(
        args.details,
        encoding="utf-8-sig",
        low_memory=False
    )

    df["raw_event_id"] = (
        df["raw_event_id"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    df["risk_score"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df["risk_score"],
        errors="coerce"
    ).fillna(0.0)

    df["is_malicious"] = (
        df["is_malicious"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .isin(["true", "1", "yes"])
    )

    score_map = dict(
        zip(
            df["raw_event_id"],
            df["risk_score"]
        )
    )

    scenarios = load_scenarios(
        Path(args.answers),
        args.dataset
    )

    rows = []

    t = args.start

    while t <= args.end + 1e-9:
        pred = df["risk_score"] >= t
        truth = df["is_malicious"]

        tp = int((truth & pred).sum())
        fp = int((~truth & pred).sum())
        tn = int((~truth & ~pred).sum())
        fn = int((truth & ~pred).sum())

        precision = safe_div(
            tp,
            tp + fp
        )

        recall = safe_div(
            tp,
            tp + fn
        )

        fpr = safe_div(
            fp,
            fp + tn
        )

        f1 = (
            safe_div(
                2 * precision * recall,
                precision + recall
            )
            if precision + recall
            else 0.0
        )

        evaluable = 0
        scenario_detected = 0

        for ids in scenarios:
            present = [
                eid
                for eid in ids
                if eid in score_map
            ]

            if not present:
                continue

            evaluable += 1

            if any(
                score_map[eid] >= t
                for eid in present
            ):
                scenario_detected += 1

        scenario_rate = safe_div(
            scenario_detected,
            evaluable
        )

        combined = (
            scenario_rate * 0.55
            + (1 - fpr) * 0.25
            + recall * 0.20
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "threshold": round(t, 2),
                "TP": tp,
                "FP": fp,
                "TN": tn,
                "FN": fn,
                "precision_pct": round(
                    precision * 100,
                    2
                ),
                "recall_pct": round(
                    recall * 100,
                    2
                ),
                "fpr_pct": round(
                    fpr * 100,
                    2
                ),
                "f1_pct": round(
                    f1 * 100,
                    2
                ),
                "scenario_detected":
                    scenario_detected,
                "scenario_total":
                    evaluable,
                "scenario_detection_pct":
                    round(
                        scenario_rate * 100,
                        2
                    ),
                "combined_score":
                    round(
                        combined,
                        4
                    ),
            }
        )

        t += args.step

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    out.to_csv(
        args.output,
        index=False,
        encoding="utf-8-sig"
    )

    print("\n[?꾧퀎媛??먯깋 寃곌낵]")
    print(
        out.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    print("\n[異붿쿇 ?곸쐞 5媛?")

    print(
        out.sort_values(
            [
                "combined_score",
                "scenario_detection_pct",
                "fpr_pct"
            ],
            ascending=[
                False,
                False,
                True
            ]
        )
        .head(5)
        .to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    print(
        f"\n[??? {args.output}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def create_normal_behavior(db):
    print("\n[1] ?뺤긽 ?됰룞 ?숈뒿 ?곗씠???앹꽦")

    # 湲곗〈 ?뚯뒪???ъ슜???곗씠?곕쭔 ??젣
    db.query(SecurityEvent).filter(
        SecurityEvent.user == TEST_USER
    ).delete()

    db.commit()

    now = datetime.now()

    file_event_count = 0
    process_event_count = 0

    # 理쒓렐 20???숈븞 ?됱씪 ?낅Т ?⑦꽩 ?앹꽦
    for days_ago in range(1, 21):
        target_date = now - timedelta(
            days=days_ago
        )

        # ??湲덈쭔 ?뺤긽 ?낅Т?쇰줈 ?ъ슜
        if target_date.weekday() >= 5:
            continue

        # ?됱냼 ?낅Т ?쒓컙
        for hour in [
            9,
            10,
            11,
            13,
            14,
            15,
            16,
            17
        ]:
            timestamp = target_date.replace(
                hour=hour,
                minute=0,
                second=0,
                microsecond=0
            )

            # ?됱냼 ?ъ슜?섎뒗 ?꾨줈?몄뒪
            process_name = (
                "WINWORD.EXE"
                if file_event_count % 2 == 0

            )

                user=TEST_USER,

                file_grade="?쇰컲",
                file_access_count=3,
                usb_connected=0,
                process_name=process_name,
                anomaly_score=0,
                risk_score=0,
                risk_level="LOW",
                reasons="?뺤긽 ?뚯씪 ?묎렐 ?숈뒿 ?곗씠??
            )

            db.add(
                file_event
            )

            file_event_count += 1

            # --------------------------------

            # --------------------------------

                user=TEST_USER,

import time
import requests


API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/events"


def send_event(event):
    event = {
        "source": "simulator",
        **event
    }

    try:
        response = requests.post(
            API_URL,
            json=event,
            timeout=5
        )

        if response.status_code == 200:
            result = response.json()

            print("=" * 60)

import time
import os

import requests
import subprocess
import win32ts


API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/events"
POLL_INTERVAL = 3
HOST_NAME = os.environ.get("COMPUTERNAME") or os.environ.get("HOSTNAME")


# ============================================================
# ?꾩옱 ?쒖꽦 Windows ?ъ슜??議고쉶
# ============================================================

def get_active_user():
    try:
        # ?꾩옱 ?ㅼ젣濡??쒖꽦?붾릺???덈뒗
        # 肄섏넄 ?몄뀡 ID 議고쉶
        session_id = (
            win32ts.WTSGetActiveConsoleSessionId()
        )

        if session_id == 0xFFFFFFFF:
            return "UNKNOWN"

        # ?대떦 ?몄뀡???ъ슜???대쫫 議고쉶
        user = win32ts.WTSQuerySessionInformation(
            None,
            session_id,
            win32ts.WTSUserName
        )

        if not user:
            return "UNKNOWN"

        return user.strip()

    except Exception as error:
        print(
            f"[?쒖꽦 ?ъ슜??議고쉶 ?ㅽ뙣] {error}"
        )

        return "UNKNOWN"


# ============================================================
# ?꾩옱 ?곌껐??USB ??μ옣移?議고쉶
# ============================================================

def get_usb_storage_devices():
    powershell_command = r"""
Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly |
Where-Object {
    $_.Class -eq 'DiskDrive' -and
    $_.InstanceId -like 'USBSTOR*'
} |
ForEach-Object {
    "$($_.FriendlyName)|$($_.InstanceId)"
}
"""

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                "powershell",
                "-NoProfile",
                "-Command",
                powershell_command
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="ignore"
        )

        devices = {}

        for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()

            if not line:
                continue

            parts = line.split(
                "|",
                1
            )

            if len(parts) != 2:
                continue

            friendly_name = (
                parts[0].strip()
            )

            instance_id = (
                parts[1].strip()
            )

            if not instance_id:
                continue

            devices[
                instance_id
            ] = friendly_name

        return devices

    except Exception as error:
        print(
            f"[USB ?μ튂 議고쉶 ?ㅽ뙣] {error}"
        )

        return {}

def send_usb_event(
    user,
    device_name,
    instance_id
):
    payload = {
        "user": user,
        "event_type": "usb_connected",
        "host": HOST_NAME,
        "source": "usb_collector",
        "raw_event_id": "USB_CONNECT",
        "source_ip": None,
        "login_success": None,
        "login_fail_count": 0,
        "file_name": None,
        "file_grade": None,
        "file_access_count": 0,
        "usb_connected": 1,
        "device_name": device_name,
        "device_id": instance_id,
        "process_name": None
    }

    try:
        response = requests.post(
            API_URL,
            json=payload,
            timeout=5
        )

        if response.status_code != 200:
            print()
            print(
                f"[SIEM ?꾩넚 ?ㅽ뙣] "
                f"{response.status_code}"
            )
            print(
                response.text
            )

            return False

        result = response.json()

        print()
        print("=" * 70)
        print("[SIEM ?꾩넚 ?깃났]")
        print(
            f"?ъ슜??      : {user}"
        )
        print(
            "?대깽??      : usb_connected"
        )
        print(
            f"?μ튂紐?      : {device_name}"
        )
        print(
            f"Instance ID  : {instance_id}"
        )
        print(
            "USB Connected: 1"
        )

        print(
            f"Rule Score   : "
            f"{result.get('rule_score')}"
        )

        print(
            f"Anomaly Score: "
            f"{result.get('anomaly_score')}"
        )

        print(
            f"Baseline     : "
            f"{result.get('baseline_score', 0)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Sequence     : "
            f"{result.get('sequence_score', 0)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Risk Score   : "
            f"{result.get('risk_score')}"
        )

        print(
            f"Risk Level   : "
            f"{result.get('risk_level')}"
        )

        reasons = result.get(
            "reasons",
            []
        )

        if reasons:
            print("?먯? ?댁쑀:")

            for reason in reasons:
                print(
                    f"  - {reason}"
                )

        print("=" * 70)

        return True

    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as error:
        print()
        print(
            f"[FastAPI ?곌껐 ?ㅽ뙣] {error}"
        )

        return False

def get_xml_value(root, name):
    element = root.find(
        f".//e:EventData/e:Data[@Name='{name}']",
        NAMESPACE
    )

    if element is None:
        return None

    value = element.text

    if value in (
        None,
        "",
        "-"
    ):
        return None

    return value


def get_system_value(root, tag):
    element = root.find(
        f".//e:System/e:{tag}",
        NAMESPACE
    )

    if element is None:
        return None

    return element.text


def get_record_id(root):
    value = get_system_value(
        root,
        "EventRecordID"
    )

    if value is None:
        return 0

    try:
        return int(value)

    except ValueError:
        return 0


def get_event_id(root):
    value = get_system_value(
        root,
        "EventID"
    )

    if value is None:
        return None

    try:
        return int(value)

    except ValueError:
        return None

def is_ignored_user(user):
    if not user:
        return True

    ignored_users = {
        "SYSTEM",
        "LOCAL SERVICE",
        "NETWORK SERVICE",
        "ANONYMOUS LOGON"
    }

    if user.upper() in ignored_users:
        return True

    if user.endswith("$"):
        return True

    return False

def parse_4624(root):

        root,
        "TargetUserName"
    )

    domain = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "TargetDomainName"
    )

    logon_type = get_xml_value(

    )

    process_name = get_xml_value(

    allowed_logon_types = {

    return {

            "process_name": process_name
        }
    }

def parse_4663(root):
    user = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "SubjectUserName"
    )

    domain = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "SubjectDomainName"
    )

    object_type = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "ObjectType"
    )

    object_name = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "ObjectName"
    )

    access_mask = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "AccessMask"
    )

    access_list = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "AccessList"
    )

    process_path = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "ProcessName"
    )

    process_name = None

    if process_path:
        process_name = ntpath.basename(
            process_path
        )

    if is_ignored_user(user):
        return None

    if object_type is None:
        return None

    if object_type.lower() != "file":
        return None

    if not object_name:
        return None

    normalized_object = os.path.normcase(
        os.path.normpath(object_name)
    )

    normalized_folder = os.path.normcase(
        os.path.normpath(MONITORED_FOLDER)
    )

    # C:\SIEM_TEST 諛붽묑???뚯씪? 臾댁떆
    try:
        common_path = os.path.commonpath(
            [
                normalized_object,
                normalized_folder
            ]
        )

    except ValueError:
        return None

    if common_path != normalized_folder:
        return None

    # ?대뜑 ?먯껜 ?묎렐? ?쒖쇅
    if normalized_object == normalized_folder:
        return None

    # ?ㅼ젣 ?뚯씪 ?곗씠???쎄린留??섏쭛
    # 0x1 = FILE_READ_DATA
    if access_mask is None:
        return None

    try:
        access_value = int(
            access_mask,
            16
        )

    except ValueError:
        return None

    # FILE_READ_DATA 鍮꾪듃 寃??    if not (access_value & 0x1):
        return None

    # MVP:
    # SIEM_TEST ?대? ?뚯씪? 以묒슂 臾몄꽌濡?媛꾩＜
    file_grade = "??몃퉬"

    return {
        "user": user,
        "event_type": "file_access",
        "source_ip": None,
        "login_success": None,
        "login_fail_count": 0,
        "file_name": object_name,
        "file_grade": file_grade,
        "file_access_count": 1,
        "usb_connected": 0,
        "process_name": process_name,
        "_display": {
            "title": "4663 以묒슂 ?뚯씪 ?묎렐",
            "domain": domain,
            "access_list": access_list,
            "access_mask": access_mask,
            "process_path": process_path
        }
    }


# ============================================================
# ?꾩옱 ??뷀삎 Windows ?ъ슜???뺤씤
# ============================================================

def get_active_console_user():
    try:
        session_id = win32ts.WTSGetActiveConsoleSessionId()

        if session_id == 0xFFFFFFFF:
            return None

        user = win32ts.WTSQuerySessionInformation(
            None,
            session_id,
            win32ts.WTSUserName
        )

        if not user:
            return None

        user = user.strip()

        if not user:
            return None

        return user

    except Exception:
        return None


# ============================================================
# 4688 - ?꾨줈?몄뒪 ?앹꽦
# ============================================================

def parse_4688(root):
    original_user = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "SubjectUserName"
    )

    user = original_user

    domain = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "SubjectDomainName"
    )

    process_path = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "NewProcessName"
    )

    parent_process = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "ParentProcessName"
    )

    command_line = get_xml_value(
        root,
        "CommandLine"
    )

    process_name = None

    if process_path:
        process_name = ntpath.basename(
            process_path
        )

    attribution_method = "event_subject"

    # ?쇰? Windows 11 ?⑦궎吏???깆쓽 4688? ?ㅼ젣 ?ъ슜?????    # DESKTOP-XXXX$ ?뺥깭??而댄벂??怨꾩젙?쇰줈 湲곕줉?????덈떎.
    # ?좏깮 ?섏쭛 ????꾨줈?몄뒪???쒗빐?쒕쭔 ?쒖꽦 肄섏넄 ?ъ슜?먮줈 蹂댁젙?쒕떎.
    if (
        user
        and user.endswith("$")
        and process_name
        and process_name.lower() in MONITORED_PROCESSES
    ):
        active_user = get_active_console_user()

        if active_user:
            user = active_user
            attribution_method = "active_console_user"

    if is_ignored_user(user):
        return None

    if process_name is None:
        return None

    # 4688 ?대깽????＜ 諛⑹?:
    # 紐⑤뱺 ?꾨줈?몄뒪瑜??꾩넚?섏? ?딄퀬 媛쒖씤 ?낅Т?⑦꽩 ?숈뒿 ?먮뒗
    # 蹂댁븞 遺꾩꽍???섎? ?덈뒗 ?꾨줈?몄뒪留?SIEM ?꾩넚 ??곸쑝濡??④릿??
    if process_name.lower() not in MONITORED_PROCESSES:
        return None

    return {
        "user": user,
        "event_type": "process_execution",
        "source_ip": None,
        "login_success": None,
        "login_fail_count": 0,
        "file_access_count": 0,
        "usb_connected": 0,
        "process_name": process_name,
        "_display": {
            "title": "4688 ?꾨줈?몄뒪 ?앹꽦",
            "domain": domain,
            "process_path": process_path,
            "parent_process": parent_process,
            "command_line": command_line,
            "original_user": original_user,
            "attribution_method": attribution_method
        }
    }


# ============================================================
# 4688 ?꾨줈?몄뒪 ?꾩넚 荑⑤떎??# ============================================================

def is_process_in_cooldown(payload):
    if payload.get("event_type") != "process_execution":
        return False

    user = (payload.get("user") or "").strip().lower()
    process_name = (payload.get("process_name") or "").strip().lower()

    if not user or not process_name:
        return False

    key = (user, process_name)
    now = time.monotonic()
    last_sent = process_last_sent.get(key)

    if (
        last_sent is not None
        and now - last_sent < PROCESS_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
    ):
        return True

    process_last_sent[key] = now

    # ?μ떆媛??ㅽ뻾 ???뺤뀛?덈━媛 遺덊븘?뷀븯寃?而ㅼ???寃껋쓣 諛⑹?
    expired_before = now - (PROCESS_COOLDOWN_SECONDS * 10)

    expired_keys = [
        item_key
        for item_key, sent_time in process_last_sent.items()
        if sent_time < expired_before
    ]

    for item_key in expired_keys:
        process_last_sent.pop(item_key, None)

    return False


# ============================================================
# XML ?대깽??遺꾩꽍
# ============================================================

def parse_event_xml(xml_text):
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(
            xml_text
        )

    except ET.ParseError as error:
        print(
            f"[XML ?뚯떛 ?ㅽ뙣] {error}"
        )

        return None, None, None

    event_id = get_event_id(
        root
    )

    record_id = get_record_id(
        root
    )

    if event_id == 4624:
        payload = parse_4624(
            root
        )

    elif event_id == 4625:
        payload = parse_4625(
            root
        )

    elif event_id == 4663:
        payload = parse_4663(
            root
        )

    elif event_id == 4688:
        payload = parse_4688(
            root
        )

    else:
        payload = None

    if payload is not None:
        payload["host"] = HOST_NAME
        payload["source"] = "windows_event_log"
        payload["raw_event_id"] = str(event_id) if event_id is not None else None

        # ?먮낯 Windows EventRecordID???숈씪 Event ID??媛쒕퀎 ?덉퐫?쒕? 援щ텇?섎뒗 媛믪씠??
        # API 怨듯넻 ?ㅽ궎留덉뿉??raw_event_id瑜??먮낯 ?대깽??醫낅쪟濡??먭퀬,
        # ?몃? Record ID??Collector 異쒕젰?먯꽌 怨꾩냽 ?뺤씤?쒕떎.

        if payload.get("event_type") == "file_access":
            payload["file_path"] = payload.get("file_name")

    return (
        event_id,
        record_id,
        payload
    )


# ============================================================
# ?곕???異쒕젰 ?щ? 寃곗젙
# ============================================================

def should_print_event(event_id, payload):
    # 濡쒓렇???깃났/?ㅽ뙣? 以묒슂 ?뚯씪 ?묎렐? ??긽 異쒕젰
    if event_id in (
        4624,
        4625,
        4663
    ):
        return True

    # 4688? ?좏깮 ?섏쭛 ?꾨줈?몄뒪留?異쒕젰
    if event_id == 4688:
        process_name = (
            payload.get("process_name")
            or ""
        ).lower()

        if process_name in MONITORED_PROCESSES:
            return True

        return False

    return False

# FastAPI ?꾩넚
